Screening report

Decision maker: Hypothetical fund partners (Technical/IP-led and Commercial/traction-led)

Evidence reviewed as of: 2026-11-04 · Generated on: 2026-11-07

Which early-stage New Zealand startups should a hypothetical generalist seed/Series A fund prioritise for its next due-diligence slots? Eight real companies, public information as of 4 November 2026, rated by the study author against written rubrics. A screening and prioritisation model: not investment advice, not a prediction of success; the companies were not contacted and are not affiliated.

Read this first

  • It rests on the information recorded in the project and, where supplied, its evidence dossier.
  • 71 of 128 scored ratings rest on judgement alone (71 of 112 qualitative or ordinal ratings).
